StopRtcRobotInstance.description_zh: 停止一个RTC互动AI智能体实例

SubmitAIAgentVideoAuditTask.description_en: Submits a video to a specified AI agent for content moderation. This operation supports video input from OSS and delivers the results asynchronously via callbacks. You can define custom frame-capturing policies and moderation prompts
SubmitAIAgentVideoAuditTask.description_zh: 该接口是一个视频送审服务,通过AI智能体对视频内容进行审核,支持OSS输入,允许用户自定义视频截帧策略和审核规则,并通过异步回调的方式返回审核结果

SubmitASRJob.description_en: Extracts time start and end points along with corresponding text information from video speech
SubmitASRJob.description_zh: 根据视频语音提取时间起止点及对应文字信息

SubmitAudioProduceJob.description_en: Converts provided text content into a high-quality speech audio file
SubmitAudioProduceJob.description_zh: 本接口用于将提供的文本内容转换成高质量的语音音频文件

SubmitAvatarTrainingJob.description_en: Use this operation to submit a new avatar training job or to resubmit a failed job
SubmitAvatarTrainingJob.description_zh:
调用此接口来正式提交数字人训练任务：
首次提交训练；
在训练失败后重新提交训练

SubmitAvatarVideoJob.description_en: Renders an avatar video from text or an audio file
SubmitAvatarVideoJob.description_zh: 以人声音频或文本作为输入，渲染虚拟人视频

SubmitBatchMediaProducingJob.description_en: Intelligently mixes and edits multiple video, audio, and image materials to batch-produce videos with one click
SubmitBatchMediaProducingJob.description_zh: 将多个视频、音频、图片素材进行智能混剪，一键批量合成视频

SubmitCopyrightExtractJob.description_en: Submits a copyright watermark extraction job
SubmitCopyrightExtractJob.description_zh: 提交版权水印提取作业

SubmitCopyrightJob.description_en: Submits a video copyright watermark job
SubmitCopyrightJob.description_zh: 调用SubmitCopyrightJob提交视频版权水印任务

SubmitCosyVoiceCustomizedVoiceJob.description_en: Submits a CosyVoice voice cloning training task
SubmitCosyVoiceCustomizedVoiceJob.description_zh: 提交CosyVoice版本人声克隆训练任务

SubmitCustomizedVoiceJob.description_en: Submits a voice cloning task of the Basic edition
SubmitCustomizedVoiceJob.description_zh: 提交基础版本人声克隆任务

SubmitDynamicChartJob.description_en: Submits a job to generate a dynamic chart video, such as a Line Chart, Pie Chart, or Bar Chart, from Excel data. You can customize chart elements like line colors and fonts
SubmitDynamicChartJob.description_zh: 根据Excel生成折线图、饼图、柱状图等视频，支持修改线条颜色、字体等信息

SubmitDynamicImageJob.description_en: Use this API to submit a task to generate a dynamic image
SubmitDynamicImageJob.description_zh: 本接口用于提交生成动态图像的任务

SubmitIProductionJob.description_en: Submits an intelligent production job by calling SubmitIProductionJob
SubmitIProductionJob.description_zh: 调用SubmitIProductionJob提交智能生产任务

SubmitLiveEditingJob.description_en: Live editing combines one or more live stream segments into a finished product. After you submit a live editing task, the task enters a background queue and is executed asynchronously. After submission, you can call the GetLiveEditingJob operation to query the job status by jobId. You can also call the GetMediaInfo operation to query information about the generated media asset by MediaId
SubmitLiveEditingJob.description_zh: 直播剪辑指将一个或多个直播流区间合成为成品。提交直播剪辑任务后，任务将进入后台排队，异步执行。提交后可以调用查询直播剪辑作业（GeLiveEditingJob ）接口根据 jobId 来查询作业状态。 也可调用获取媒资内容信息（GetMediaInfo）接口根据 MediaId 来查询生成媒资的信息

SubmitLiveRecordJob.description_en: Submits a real-time recording task to record a live stream by calling SubmitLiveRecordJob
SubmitLiveRecordJob.description_zh: 调用SubmitLiveRecordJob提交实时录制任务，对直播流进行录制

SubmitLiveSnapshotJob.description_en: Submits a real-time snapshot task. If submitted during an active stream, the task starts automatically and asynchronously. Otherwise, the task remains in an unstarted state
SubmitLiveSnapshotJob.description_zh: 调用SubmitLiveSnapshotJob提交实时截图任务。如果在推流中提交，则会自动异步启动任务，否则为未启动状态

SubmitLiveTranscodeJob.description_zh: 调用本接口提交实时转码任务

SubmitMediaAiAnalysisJob.description_en: Perform structured analysis on media assets to enable speaker analysis, video translation, paragraph summarization, and other analyses on videos
SubmitMediaAiAnalysisJob.description_zh: 对媒资进行结构化分析，可以对视频进行发言人分析、视频翻译、段落概要等分析

SubmitMediaCensorJob.description_en: Submits a media file to Intelligent Media Services for a censor job. This API automates the scanning of video, audio, or image content to detect potentially non-compliant, sensitive, or inappropriate material
SubmitMediaCensorJob.description_zh: 允许用户想智能媒体服务提交一个媒体文件的审核任务，该接口支持对视频、音频或图像内容进行自动化的审核，以检测其中可能包含的违规、敏感或不适宜的内容

SubmitMediaInfoJob.description_en: Creates an asynchronous job to retrieve media information
SubmitMediaInfoJob.description_zh: 提交媒体信息异步任务

SubmitMediaProducingJob.description_en: Commits a media editing and compositing job. When you need to perform editing, compositing, or other forms of post-production on video or audio materials, you can invoke this API operation to automate the processing
SubmitMediaProducingJob.description_zh: SubmitMediaProducingJob接口主要用于提交一个媒体剪辑合成任务。当用户需要对视频或音频素材进行剪辑、合成或其他形式的后期制作时，可以通过调用此API接口来实现自动化处理

SubmitSceneBatchEditingJob.description_en: Submits a batch job to render multiple videos by providing a list of editing project IDs
SubmitSceneBatchEditingJob.description_zh: 输入多个剪辑工程ID，批量提交时间线合成，生成多个视频

SubmitSceneMediaSelectionJob.description_en: Selects suitable clips based on the submitted videos, images, and voiceovers, and returns the selection results. Two scenarios are supported: image-text matching and highlight mashup
SubmitSceneMediaSelectionJob.description_zh: 根据传入的视频、图片、口播等素材，挑选合适的素材片段，并返回挑选结果。支持两种场景：智能匹配、高燃混剪

SubmitSceneTimelineOrganizationJob.description_en: Arranges media assets, including videos, images, background music, and voiceovers, into a complete timeline based on media selection results, and creates an editing project for preview. Two scenarios are supported: image-text matching and highlight mashup
SubmitSceneTimelineOrganizationJob.description_zh: 根据素材挑选结果，将视频、图片、背景音乐、口播等素材编排成完整时间线，并创建剪辑工程以便预览。支持两种场景：智能匹配、高燃混剪

SubmitScreenMediaHighlightsJob.description_en: Analyzes media assets, such as short-form dramas, to automatically identify highlight clips and generate a highlight compilation
SubmitScreenMediaHighlightsJob.description_zh: 输入短剧等影视素材，自动识别高光片段，合成高燃成片

SubmitSegmentationJob.description_en: Submits a job to segment a long video into multiple video segments. The output can be multiple video files or a new media asset
SubmitSegmentationJob.description_zh: 将一个长视频拆分成多个视频片段，输出多个视频文件或输出为媒资

SubmitSnapshotJob.description_en: This API submits a snapshot job. Specify a media file by its ID or URL, a time point, and the desired format. The API then generates the snapshot and saves it to the specified location
SubmitSnapshotJob.description_zh: 本接口用于提交截图任务。通过该接口，用户可以指定媒体文件的ID或URL，以及截图的时间点和格式，系统将根据这些参数生成截图并保存到指定的位置

SubmitSportsHighlightsJob.description_en: Starts a job to generate a highlight video from sports footage with commentary
SubmitSportsHighlightsJob.description_zh: 输入包含解说的体育赛事素材，自动生成体育赛事集锦视频

SubmitStandardCustomizedVoiceJob.description_en: Submits a voice cloning task of the basic edition. After you call this operation, a JobId is synchronously returned. The training process is asynchronous. During training, you can call the GetCustomizedVoiceJob operation to query whether the current task is completed and obtain the training status
SubmitStandardCustomizedVoiceJob.description_zh: 提交大众版本的人声克隆任务。调用此接口后，会同步返回 JobId，训练过程为异步过程。在训练期间，您可以通过调用 GetCustomizedVoiceJob - 查询人声克隆训练任务接口来获取当前任务是否完成或训练状态等信息

SubmitSyncMediaInfoJob.description_en: Submits a media file in synchronous mode for media information analysis
SubmitSyncMediaInfoJob.description_zh: 调用SubmitSyncMediaInfoJob以同步模式提交媒体文件进行媒体信息分析

SubmitTextGenerateJob.description_en: Generates marketing copy based on the provided keywords, text length, and number of copy variations. Due to the complexities of the Chinese language, the length of the output text may differ from the requested length. After submitting the job, call the `GetSmartHandleJob` operation with the returned job ID to query the job status and retrieve the results
SubmitTextGenerateJob.description_zh: 根据提交的关键词、字数、文案数，扩写出营销文案。由于中文的特殊性，输出文案字数可能跟需求字数有出入。提交任务成功后，根据JobId调用GetSmartHandleJob接口获取任务状态和结果

SubmitTraceAbJob.description_en: Submits a job to generate A/B stream variants of a video for forensic watermarking
SubmitTraceAbJob.description_zh: 提交视频溯源水印ab流任务

SubmitTraceExtractJob.description_en: Submits a trace watermark extraction job
SubmitTraceExtractJob.description_zh: 提交溯源水印提取任务

SubmitTraceM3u8Job.description_en: Submits a job to process an M3U8 file for video watermarking for tracing
SubmitTraceM3u8Job.description_zh: 提交视频溯源水印m3u8文件任务

SubmitTranscodeJob.description_en: Submits a transcoding job for a video or audio file to Intelligent Media Services by specifying the source file, output format, and related parameters
SubmitTranscodeJob.description_zh: 用户可以调用SubmitTranscodeJob接口，指定需要转码的源文件、输出格式以及相关参数，并提交视频或音频文件的转码任务到智能媒体服务

SubmitVideoTranslationJob.description_en: Call this operation to submit a video translation job. This service can translate subtitles and spoken content, and generate lip-sync for the translated audio
SubmitVideoTranslationJob.description_zh: 通过本接口，您可以提交视频翻译任务。当前已支持字幕级翻译（将视频中出现的字幕翻译为指定语言）、声音（口播）级翻译（将音频中的口播内容翻译为指定语言）与面容级翻译（口型适配）

SubmitYikeStoryboardJob.description_en: Submits a storyboard generation task for the Yike AI application

TakeoverAIAgentCall.description_en: Hands off a conversation to a human agent
TakeoverAIAgentCall.description_zh: 切换真人客服接管模式

UpdateAIAgentInstance.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a specified AI agent instance
UpdateAIAgentInstance.description_zh: 修改指定AI智能体实例的配置信息

UpdateAvatarTrainingJob.description_en: Modifies a digital human training job. You can modify the basic information or update parameters such as Video and Transparent for retraining if the training failed
UpdateAvatarTrainingJob.description_zh:
调用此接口能够修改数字人训练任务的信息，包括：
修改基本信息；
在训练失败后，更新 Video、Transparent 等信息后重新进行训练

UpdateCustomTemplate.description_en: Modifies the information of a user-defined template for media processing
UpdateCustomTemplate.description_zh: 修改媒体处理用户自定义模板信息

UpdateCustomizedVoice.description_en: Updates a personalized human voice. Only the media asset ID of the sample audio file can be modified
UpdateCustomizedVoice.description_zh: 调用此接口可以修改个性化人声的信息，目前仅支持修改示例音频媒资ID，以支持自行维护示例音频

UpdateEditingProject.description_en: Modifies a cloud editing project. You can modify the title, timeline, and cover image of the project
UpdateEditingProject.description_zh: 修改云剪辑工程，支持修改标题、时间线和封面等

UpdateHotwordLibrary.description_en: Modifies a specified hotword library, including its name, description, and hotword list
UpdateHotwordLibrary.description_zh: 用于更新指定热词库的信息，包括名称、描述和热词列表

UpdateLivePackageChannel.description_en: Updates the channel configuration in the live packaging service, including the protocol, duration, and segment count
UpdateLivePackageChannel.description_zh: 更新实时打包服务中的频道配置，包括协议、时长与切片数量等

UpdateLivePackageChannelCredentials.description_en: Updates the credentials of ingest endpoints associated with a live package channel
UpdateLivePackageChannelCredentials.description_zh: 实时打包服务API，用于刷新指定频道的输入端点密钥

UpdateLivePackageChannelGroup.description_en: Updates the information about a live package channel group including its description
UpdateLivePackageChannelGroup.description_zh: 更新实时打包服务中的频道组信息，包括描述

UpdateLivePackageOriginEndpoint.description_en: Updates the origin endpoint configuration of a channel group for live packaging, including protocol, time-shifting settings, and access control
UpdateLivePackageOriginEndpoint.description_zh: 更新频道组的实时打包源站端点配置，支持协议、时移设置及访问控制

UpdateLiveRecordTemplate.description_en: Updates the information about a live stream recording template
UpdateLiveRecordTemplate.description_zh: 调用UpdateLiveRecordTemplate更新实时录制模板

UpdateLiveSnapshotTemplate.description_en: Updates the information about a live stream snapshot template

UpdateLiveTranscodeJob.description_en: Updates the information about a live stream transcoding job
UpdateLiveTranscodeJob.description_zh: 调用UpdateLiveTranscodeJob更新实时转码任务信息

UpdateLiveTranscodeTemplate.description_en: Updates the information about a live stream transcoding template

UpdateMediaConnectFlowInput.description_en: Modify the input information of a specific MediaConnect flow

UpdateMediaConnectFlowOutput.description_en: Modifies an output of a MediaConnect flow
UpdateMediaConnectFlowOutput.description_zh: 修改某个MediaConnect Flow实例的某个output

UpdateMediaConnectFlowStatus.description_en: Modifies the state of a MediaConnect flow

UpdateMediaInfo.description_en: Updates information about a media asset based on the ID of the media asset in Intelligent Media Services (IMS) or the input URL of the media asset
UpdateMediaInfo.description_zh: 根据IMS mediaId或媒资InputURL，更新一个媒资的媒资信息

UpdateMediaLiveInputSecurityGroup.description_en: Modifies a security group created in MediaLive
UpdateMediaLiveInputSecurityGroup.description_zh: 更新媒体直播输入安全组

UpdateMediaToSearchLib.description_en: Update media asset information in the search library
UpdateMediaToSearchLib.description_zh: 在搜索库中更新媒资信息

UpdatePipeline.description_en: Updates the information about an ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) queue

UpdateProgram.description_en: Modifies a program in a MediaWeaver channel

UpdateRtcRobotInstance.description_en: Updates the configuration of an RTC AI Agent instance, such as its voice and greeting
UpdateRtcRobotInstance.description_zh: 修改一个RTC互动AI智能体实例配置，如音色、欢迎语等

UpdateTemplate.description_en: Modifies an online editing template. You can modify the template title and template configurations
UpdateTemplate.description_zh: 调用UpdateTemplate接口修改云剪辑模板，支持修改模板标题、模板配置等信息

UploadMediaByURL.description_en: Invokes the UploadMediaByURL operation to pull audio and video media files from source file URLs for upload. Batch uploads are supported. This operation is mainly applicable to scenarios where files are not stored on a local service or terminal and need to be uploaded through a URL that supports public network access
UploadMediaByURL.description_zh: 调用UploadMediaByURL基于源文件URL，拉取音视频媒体文件进行上传，支持批量上传。本接口主要适用于文件没有存储在本地服务器或终端，需要通过公网访问的URL地址上传的场景

UploadStreamByURL.description_en: Uploads a media stream file based on the URL of the source file
UploadStreamByURL.description_zh: 调用UploadStreamByURL基于源文件URL，拉取媒体流文件并上传至VOD点播存储中。上传完成后，该媒体流将自动挂载到指定的MediaId下
